selection_rule: Only findings with an explicit responsible decision, public product owner, public necessity, sanitization pass, target contract/test, source commit, and negative case are selected.

selected.negative_case: extra undeclared capability fails closure or launch
substantive execution change without re-evaluation is rejected
CURRENT, handoff, or progress file cannot become active authority
local contract without a stable remote WorkItem binding cannot activate
exploration does not create an Issue or start implementation without explicit activation
